Class FileLineExtract

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.io.FileLineExtract

  • public class FileLineExtract
extends java.lang.Object

    Title: Hec Java Development

    Description: Extracts entire line out of a file and writes it to another file. The line is choosen by passing in a "First Word". The "First Word" must be correct and include any spaces.
